将她的头发盘成一款优雅、传统灵感的高发髻,丰盈的发量在脑后聚拢,由两根简约的深色发簪横向固定。两侧脸庞留有松散、微微卷曲的鬓丝,头顶与太阳穴周围带有细腻的碎发。保留她可辨认的发际线与自然的面部比例。呈现一缕一缕的发丝、真实的光泽与细微的不完美,营造真实的私人照片质感。

妆容

采用精致、女性化的妆容:柔和立体的眉形、细腻的暖棕色眼影、细致的眼线、自然泛红的脸颊,以及带光泽的哑光玫瑰色唇妆。保持女孩原本的眼型、瞳色、面部特征与肤色不变。保留真实的毛孔、自然的肤质与细微的不完美。避免过度磨皮或人为的美颜滤镜。

为她穿上一件做工精致、复古灵感的中国花卉旗袍(qipao / cheongsam),色调为低饱和的灰蓝雾色。裙子应具备以下特征:

name: flowers-upscale
description: Photo to 8K; 2/3-pass contextual AI crop enhancement and registered blending.
---
INPUT S=uploaded photo; missing→request. Unspecified→ask "2 passes (recommended) or 3? 8K default; another resolution?" Await choice. N=2|3; L=specified longest edge else8192; preserve aspect. Discover available AI image-editing+raster-processing capabilities; missing→report requirement. Use environment-native tools/paths; create helpers as needed. Preserve S; separate outputs. Execute end-to-end after choice.

E(C): inspect; AI-edit inputs=[S=context,C=target], maximum practical supported resolution; retain actual output dimensions. Prompt=Q+only relevant material constraints. Concurrent independent calls where supported; persist outputs+source-coordinate boxes+prompts immediately.

P1: S→3×3 cores; pad each side20% core dimension, clip to S→9 overlapping C→E→register/blend→M1; resize assembled M1 to L.
P2: M1→4–8 padded salient ROIs(face/hair/hands/objects/textiles as present)→E→register/blend→M2. Exclude low-information regions.
N=3: M2→4–8 tighter focal ROIs(individual eyes/lips/nose/fingers/material details as present)→E→register/blend→M3. Keep homologous features consistent. Every E receives S, never crop alone.

Q="1=original: identity/anatomy/color/light authority. 2=target: return exact crop/framing/geometry. Reconstruct plausible photographic detail; preserve expression, pose, contours, clothing, genuine imperfections, focus falloff. Optical clarity; natural edge transitions; spatially varied texture. Repair inherited artifacts. Skin: irregular pores/fine creases, quiet intervals. Hair: cohesive groups, selective fibers, natural sparse fringe. Iris: source color, irregular branching fibers, coherent pupil, restrained reflections. Textiles: original weave direction/spacing/motifs. Avoid invented structures/marks, beautification, relighting, halos, ringing, embossed/crosshatched/repeated texture, synthetic grain, blanket sharpening."

ASSEMBLE: map recorded boxes→master; global similarity registration first; bounded smooth local correction only with reliable correspondence, never distort rigid geometry/repeating patterns. Unreliable→retain prior pixels. Match broad exposure/color without transferring old fine texture. Normalized overlap/multiband blend; feather15–25% border→alpha0 at interior patch boundaries. Preserve native enhanced crops. Before next pass: inspect full image+100% focal/overlap crops; repair doubling/seams/drift/texture mismatch. ≤2 targeted retries/defect; rejected/failed→retain prior content+disclose.

EXPORT: M_N→lossless PNG at L; verify dimensions+decode; deliver file+preview+prompts/settings. Describe detail as reconstructed; distinguish exported resolution from native generated resolution.

Also, an important point: run it in Codex/Work rather than the standard chat, and bump the effort level up to at least "high."

On the downside, it takes *forever* to think. The first image took me 10 minutes, and each subsequent one took even longer than the last 😐

You can also use any other image-generating agent instead of GPT - like Gemini + Nanobanana - though the result depends heavily on the agent's "brains."

I got the best quality using the Opus 5.5 + Codex CLI image gen combo (a photo of a young Elon), but that was also the longest run by far 😁

name: flowers-upscale（花卉上采样）
description: 将照片提升至 8K；通过 2/3 轮上下文式 AI 增强与配准混合。
---
INPUT（输入）S=上传的照片；缺失→请求补发。未指定→询问"2 轮（推荐）还是 3 轮？默认 8K；需要其他分辨率吗？" 等待选择。N=2|3；L=指定的最长边，否则为 8192；保持原始比例。探明可用的 AI 图像编辑 + 光栅处理能力；不可用→报告需求。使用环境原生工具与路径；按需创建辅助程序。保留 S；输出与原图分离。选择完成后端到端执行。

E(C)：检查；AI 编辑输入=[S=context,C=target]，采用实际支持的最大分辨率；保留实际输出尺寸。Prompt=Q+仅与素材相关的约束。在支持的条件下并发独立调用；立即持久化输出 + 源坐标框 + prompt。

P1：S→3×3 核心；每侧填充核心尺寸的 20%，裁剪回 S→9 个重叠的 C→E→配准/混合→M1；将组装后的 M1 缩放到 L。
P2：M1→4–8 个带填充的显著 ROI（面部/头发/手部/物体/织物，按存在情况）→E→配准/混合→M2。排除低信息区域。
N=3：M2→4–8 个更紧凑的焦距 ROI（单眼/嘴唇/鼻子/手指/材质细节，按存在情况）→E→配准/混合→M3。保持同源特征一致。每次 E 都接收 S，绝不单独处理裁剪。

PHOTO → BOTANICAL INK & COLOR-BLOCK ILLUSTRATION Transform the uploaded photo into a stylish hand-drawn illustration inspired by botanical ink sketching combined with bold abstract color fields. Redraw the entire image. 100% illustration, 0% photography. PRESERVE THE ORIGINAL: Keep the original composition, main subject, pose, proportions, recognizable facial features if a person is present, hairstyle, clothing silhouette and important objects. Do not change the identity or basic structure of the scene. STYLE: Reinterpret the photo using a striking contrast between: • very fine black ink linework • delicate botanical-style contour drawing • large flat organic color shapes • small scattered color dots and rounded patches • generous untouched warm-white paper The illustration should feel handmade, artistic and slightly imperfect, like a drawing created with a fine black fineliner and broad marker strokes in a spiral sketchbook. LINEWORK: Draw the main subject primarily with thin, elegant black lines. Use flowing contour lines and fine parallel hatching to describe form, shadows, hair, clothing folds and important details. Avoid realistic rendering and smooth digital shading. Some areas should contain intricate black linework while others remain almost completely empty. COLOR PALETTE — CRITICAL: Analyze the uploaded photo and extract its most visually characteristic colors. Choose: • 2 dominant colors from the original image • 1 contrasting or complementary accent color derived naturally from the photo Use ONLY these selected colors together with black ink and warm white paper. Do not copy every color from the photograph. COLOR BLOCKS: Place large irregular organic color fields behind, around and occasionally partially across the subject. The shapes should look loosely hand-painted with broad markers: rounded blobs, imperfect circles, asymmetric patches and softly geometric forms. Do NOT precisely fill objects with color. Instead, allow the color blocks and black drawing to overlap independently, creating an intentional screen-print / sketchbook effect. Add a few much smaller colored dots or patches around the composition to create rhythm and balance. SUBJECT: The subject must remain clearly recognizable from the original photo, but translated completely into this graphic language. If a person is present, preserve recognizable facial proportions and characteristic features through economical black linework rather than realism. Use fewer lines on the face so it stays clean and readable. BACKGROUND: Strongly simplify the original background. Do not reproduce every background detail. Translate only a few important environmental elements into delicate black outlines. Replace most of the background with warm-white negative space and abstract color fields derived from the original photograph. COMPOSITION: Create an airy, asymmetric composition. Let some black contours extend beyond the color blocks. Let some colored shapes disappear behind the subject. Allow occasional color to cross the linework. The result should feel deliberately imperfect rather than digitally precise. PAPER: Warm white, slightly textured heavyweight sketchbook paper. Subtle visible paper grain. FINAL LOOK: modern botanical ink illustration, fine black fineliner, bold marker color blocks, limited photo-derived palette, organic abstract shapes, delicate hatching, lots of negative space, handmade sketchbook aesthetic, graphic but elegant, recognizable original subject. AVOID: photorealism, realistic digital painting, 3D rendering, smooth gradients, watercolor washes, colored outlines, overly detailed backgrounds, full-frame color, perfect geometric shapes, generic floral decorations, random colors unrelated to the uploaded photo, dense detail covering the entire image.

纯文生图 —— 仅依据所写的文字主题进行创意生成，无需参考图片。

核心理念：
上半部分 50% 为电影感写实场景，自然过渡到下半部分 50% 温暖象牙色纸张上的极简、俏皮手绘涂鸦艺术。一个可识别元素自然地横跨中心延伸，保持其原始形状、透视、色彩和方向。

艺术风格：
使用粗犷的马克笔笔触和不透明油漆笔，稚拙圆润的轮廓，夸张简约的形状，必要时添加微小的五官细节，以及略微抖动的手绘线条。在简化为迷人、质朴风格作品的同时保留主体的特征。

色彩与构图：
从场景中汲取灵感，选择一种主导的鲜艳色彩，外加 1–2 种点缀色。次要细节保持以纸白色为主，仅以稀疏的彩色描边点缀。使用宽大且不完美的笔触、细微的墨水不规则感，以及微小的手写英文解说文字。去除插画部分不必要的背景细节，至少保留 70% 的区域为干净的留白。

整体美学：
真实摄影 × 极简质朴涂鸦 × 连续视觉转化 × 当代旅行编辑风格。通透、俏皮、艺术且具收藏价值。

避免：
可见接缝、生硬的分界线、渐变、插画中的阴影、细节背景再现、平滑的矢量曲线、过多文字、边框、标志、水印和界面元素。

格式：
满版 4:5 竖版作品。精确的 50/50 构图，自然无缝的过渡，无外部留白。

Use @[ref1] for the ninja, @[ref2] for the creature, @[ref3] for forest and light.

Shot 1: Dutch side tracking races beside the ninja, sword in her right hand, a moonlit clearing visible ahead through rushing trunks.
Cut: Rear three-quarter tracking reveals the creature gaining behind her; a low moon hangs beyond its horned silhouette through the branches.
Cut: Low beside her as she crosses a sliver of moonlight: the blade flashes silver, but its cast shadow curls against her movement. She notices the brighter clearing and drives toward it.

Shot 2: Front-facing Dutch tracking retreats as a black column separates from the forest: the creature's right forelimb drops toward her.
Cut: Ground-level view follows her sidestep while its palm crushes her last footprint, flinging roots after her.
Cut: Lateral tracking catches its left arm sweeping across her route. She slides underneath; the missed claw splits a slender tree's base, leaving it leaning into neighboring branches.

Shot 3: Low three-quarter tracking carries the slide into her rising turn as the left claw reaches back.
Cut: Side-on contact: her right-hand sword slices its fibrous left wrist. Black strands tear; the creature recoils, opening a gap she immediately runs through.
Cut: Wider rear tracking keeps her moving toward the moonlit clearing as the creature grips the leaning tree with its intact right hand. Wood cracks under its grip.

Shot 4: Elevated Dutch view follows the grip into a wrench: the creature tears the split trunk free and thrusts it across her escape route.
Cut: Low side view as the released trunk crashes ahead of her, a low thin end beside its heavy base. She brakes through flying bark.
Cut: High oblique tracking shows the clearing just beyond the barrier. She turns toward the thin end and commits to a vault instead of retreating into darkness.

Shot 5: Low rear-quarter Dutch tracking follows her left palm onto the trunk, right-hand sword clear as she vaults.
Cut: Low frontal view as she clears it: the creature reaches over the barrier toward her landing point. She twists aside in mid-descent.
Cut: Ground-level side view catches the palm smashing beside her. Her left shoulder clips the splintered trunk, knocking out her breath; she rolls away into the clearing.

Shot 6: Close low tracking carries the roll into a painful kneeling turn, left arm held close. She faces the approaching creature, sword still in her right hand.
Cut: Wider side view establishes the low moon behind the creature as it enters the clearing. Its enormous shadow stretches across the pale ground toward her; its torn left wrist still sheds fibers.
Cut: Close on her frightened face, then reframing to her sword as she raises it into moonlight. She stops retreating. The creature lunges; its shadow reaches her knees.

Shot 7: Low contact view: she plunges the moonlit blade through the creature's advancing shadow into the soil. Silver light runs down the steel; the pierced shadow tightens like black skin.
Cut: Wide Dutch view as the creature tries to bound forward but its shadow holds its feet. Ink-black strips lift from that shadow and thread upward through its hanging body fibers, pulling them taut.
Cut: Tight tracking along its intact right arm as it tears free of the rising strips and lunges at her. She remains kneeling at the anchored sword; the claw is almost upon her.

Shot 8: Tight on her right hand twisting the buried blade as the claw rushes down. Moonlight sharpens along the steel; the pinned shadow contracts violently.
Cut: Low shared view: the claw unravels inches from her face. The collapse races up its arm into its torso, dragging its black fibers down toward its own shadow while it fights to wrench away.
Cut: Wider view holds the colossal body completely disintegrating into shredded ink ribbons and dry black dust. Its horned head breaks apart last, both white eyes extinguishing; the falling matter crumbles into lifeless ash around the pinned shadow.
Cut: The camera settles level across the empty clearing. The creature and its shadow are gone; only scattered ash remains. She kneels beside the planted sword, injured shoulder low, breathing into the sudden quiet under the same cold moonlight.

使用 @[ref1] 表示忍者，@[ref2] 表示该生物，@[ref3] 表示森林与光线。

镜头1：荷兰角侧面跟踪镜头与忍者并驰奔跑，她右手持剑，透过急速掠过的树干可见前方一片月光照耀的空地。
切换：后部三分之二跟踪镜头揭示该生物正在她身后逼近；一弯低悬的月亮从枝桠间挂在它带角的剪影之后。
切换：低位贴着她，在她穿过一缕月光时：剑刃闪烁银光，但它投下的阴影却沿她的动作卷曲。她注意到更明亮的空地，便加速冲过去。

镜头2：正面荷兰角跟踪镜头后撤，一根黑色柱状物从森林中分离出来：该生物的右前肢向她落下。
切换：地面视角跟随她的侧步，而它的掌心碾碎她最后那个脚印，将树根甩向她身后。
切换：横向跟踪镜头捕捉到它的左臂横扫过她的路线。她从下方滑过；落空的爪击劈开一棵细长树木的根部，使其倾斜着搭在邻近的树枝上。

镜头3：低位三分之二跟踪镜头将滑行动作带入她起身的转身，同时左爪向后抓来。
切换：侧面接触镜头：她右手的剑切中它那如纤维般的左腕。黑色丝缕撕裂；该生物后退，让出一个缺口，她立刻冲过去。
切换：更宽的后方跟踪镜头保持她跟出的势头，朝着月光空地前进，而该生物用完好的右手抓住那棵倾斜的树。木头在它的抓握下发出碎裂声。

镜头4：高角度荷兰角视角跟随抓握进入一个猛拧动作：该生物将劈裂的树干连根拔起，横刺向她的逃生路线。
切换：低位侧面视角，被释放的树干在她前方轰然坠落，细长的一端低伏在粗重的根部旁。她在飞溅的树皮中急停。
切换：高角度斜向跟踪镜头显示空地就在屏障之后。她转向细端，决定纵身跃过，而非退回黑暗。

镜头5：低位后部四分之一荷兰角跟踪镜头跟随她的左掌落上树干，右手持剑高举，越过树干。
切换：低位正面视角，在她越过之时：该生物从屏障上方伸向她将要落地的位置。她在半空中侧身避开。
切换：地面侧面视角捕捉到巨掌在她身侧砸下。她的左肩撞上劈裂的树干，喘不上气；她翻身滚入空地。

镜头6：贴身近距离低位跟踪镜头将翻滚带入一个痛苦的跪姿转身，左臂紧贴身侧。她面对逼近的该生物，右手仍持剑。
切换：更宽的侧面视角确立低悬的月亮在该生物身后，它进入空地。它巨大的阴影越过苍白的地面向她延伸；它被撕裂的左腕仍在掉落纤维。
切换：先贴近她受惊的面孔，再重新构图到她举剑迎向月光的脸庞。她停止后退。该生物猛扑；它的阴影抵达她的双膝。

镜头7：低位接触视角：她将月光浸染的刀刃刺穿该生物前伸的阴影，钉入泥土。银光顺着剑身流下；被刺穿的阴影收紧如黑皮。
切换：宽幅荷兰角视角，该生物试图跃前，但它的阴影锁住了它的脚。墨黑的丝带从那阴影中升起，穿过它垂悬的躯体纤维向上缠绕，将纤维拉紧。
切换：紧密跟踪镜头沿它完好的右臂推进，它撕开升起的丝带向她扑来。她仍跪在钉入地面的剑旁；利爪几乎已到眼前。

镜头8：特写她右手扭动埋入土中的刀刃，利爪飞速落下。月光沿钢刃愈发锋锐；被钉住的阴影剧烈收缩。
切换：低位共用视角：利爪在她面庞几寸处崩解。崩解沿其手臂窜上躯干，将黑色纤维拖向它自己的阴影，而它奋力挣脱。
切换：更宽的视角呈现那庞大的躯体彻底碎裂为撕碎的墨色丝带与干涸的黑色尘屑。它的带角头颅最后崩裂，两只白色眼睛熄灭；坠落的碎屑在被钉住的阴影周围碎成无生命的灰烬。
切换：镜头在空旷的空地上水平稳定下来。该生物与它的阴影都已消失；仅余散落的灰烬。她跪在插立的剑旁，受伤的肩膀低垂，在同一片冷冽月光下，喘息着面对骤然降临的寂静。

当每个瓶子都服从同一套网格时，产品家族就会显得很昂贵。

A product family looks expensive when every bottle obeys the same grid.
🍓 exactly ten identical square-shouldered bottles, evenly spaced in one horizontal lineup
Consistency is the visual promise. Matching height, cap scale, label placement, and gaps let the flavor colors read as one confident system—not ten separate products.
🧊 bottom information strip divided into ten cells, each vertically aligned to its bottle
This turns the poster into a retail-ready index. Your eye can move from bottle to flavor to benefit without searching, while the fruit wall stays where it belongs: behind the lineup, adding abundance without breaking order.

Portrait orientation, ultra-photorealistic editorial travel photograph inside a vintage seaside tram traveling along a Mediterranean coastline. Warm varnished wooden benches with visible wood grain and brass hardware, large open wooden-framed windows revealing turquoise water, rocky shoreline, and sunlit Mediterranean stone buildings outside.

A woman sits sideways on the narrow wooden bench beside the window. One leg is folded on the seat while the other extends naturally along the bench edge. Her torso angles slightly toward the viewer while leaning comfortably against the tram corner.

She wears fitted light-wash distressed denim overalls with ripped knees and rolled cuffs. One overall strap hangs loosely off one shoulder revealing a strapless floral bustier underneath. White high-top canvas sneakers, lightly worn.

One hand loosely holds a clear plastic iced coffee with a straw resting near her knee, condensation visible on the cup. Her other hand gently lifts to brush loose strands of hair back from her temple.

Loose beach-wave hair catches the warm sunlight and moves lightly in the coastal breeze entering through the open tram window. She looks directly at the camera with a relaxed half-smile and calm, confident eye contact.

Camera positioned across the narrow bench at seated eye level, creating the feeling of sharing the seat with her. Framed from mid-thigh upward with a 35mm lens. Moderately shallow depth of field keeps the subject crisp while the coastline outside softens into a natural blur.

Warm Mediterranean afternoon sunlight enters through the windows, creating soft highlights along her hair and shoulders while ocean reflections brighten the wood interior tones. Natural skin texture, realistic fabric detail, cinematic depth, balanced contrast, subtle filmic grain.

竖版构图，超写实编辑级旅行摄影，地中海海岸线上行驶的复古海边有轨电车内部。温暖的漆面木质长椅，可见木纹与黄铜五金，大型木框敞开车窗外可见绿松石色海水、岩石海岸以及阳光下的地中海石砌建筑。

一位女性侧身坐在窗边狭窄的木质长椅上。一条腿折叠放在座位上，另一条自然地沿长椅边缘伸展。她的上身微微朝向镜头，自然舒适地靠在电车角落。

她穿着合身的浅色水洗做旧牛仔背带裤，膝盖处破损，裤口卷边。一条背带松松地滑落于一侧肩膀，露出里面的无肩带花卉文胸。白色高帮帆布鞋，轻微磨损。

一只手松松地握着一杯带吸管的透明塑料冰咖啡，吸管靠近她的膝盖，杯身可见水珠凝结。她的另一只手轻轻抬起，将太阳穴旁散落的发丝拂到耳后。

随性的海滩波浪卷发捕捉到温暖的阳光，随着从敞开的车窗吹入的海滨微风轻轻飘动。她直视镜头，带着轻松的微笑和沉静自信的眼神交流。

相机置于狭窄长椅对面，与坐姿视线齐平，营造出与她同坐一席的感觉。35mm 镜头从大腿中段向上构图。中等浅景深使主体清晰锐利，窗外海岸线自然柔化为虚化背景。

温暖的地中海午后阳光透过车窗洒入，在她头发和肩膀上形成柔和的高光，海面反射使车内木质色调更加明亮。自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的织物细节、电影感景深、均衡对比度、细腻的胶片颗粒。

Premium Editorial Poster Instructions
Each uploaded photo must be transformed into a separate, independent premium editorial poster. Never combine multiple photos into one design. Use a strict 3:4 vertical canvas divided horizontally at the exact center into two equal halves, each occupying 50% of the total height and full width, without altering proportions.

The upper half must use the original photo directly without regeneration. Preserve the main subject's identity, human anatomy or architectural structure, proportions, perspective, spatial relationships, textures, natural lighting, shadows, colors, and environment exactly as shown. Only slight cropping and restrained premium color grading are permitted. Do not redraw the main subject, introduce artificial lighting, apply excessive HDR or saturation, create plastic textures, or add fictional elements. If necessary, extend only environmental areas such as the sky, water, ground, walls, plants, or background.

The lower half must reconstruct the photo's central narrative, whether it is a single primary subject or a connected group of elements representing the image's identity, scale, action, or story. Preserve realistic appearance, recognizable identity, proportions, internal structure, texture, and relative positioning. Do not remove important related elements or use a rectangular photo cutout. The reconstructed subject should occupy approximately 55%–80% of the lower half's width. Extend the subject naturally according to the scene's direction, maintaining believable ground contact, waterlines, realistic shadows, or softly fading edges. Integrate it seamlessly into the background without a sticker-like or floating appearance.

Place one narrow, low-saturation geometric color field behind or partially through the subject, creating a subtle transition between photographic realism and editorial abstraction. Extract the color from the original photo and choose a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal orientation according to the scene's narrative direction. The subject must visibly cross the color field's boundary, with part overlapping the colored area and another part extending into the open negative space. Create natural occlusion, overlap, and spatial depth. The color field must not act as a frame or card and must never completely enclose the subject. Use only one primary geometric window. Do not add multiple color blocks, thick borders, rounded corners, strong gradients, or drop shadows.

Use a white, cool-white, very light gray, or near-white background in the lower half, coordinated with the original photograph. Maintain a restrained asymmetrical composition with generous negative space and a clear visual hierarchy: the reconstructed subject as the primary focus, the low-saturation geometric window as the secondary element, and the clean background as supporting space.

上半部分必须直接使用原始照片，不得重新生成。须完整保留主体的身份、人体解剖结构或建筑结构、比例、透视、空间关系、质感、自然光影、阴影、色彩以及环境原貌。仅允许进行轻微裁剪与克制的专业调色。不得重绘主体、引入人工光源、施加过度的 HDR 或饱和度、制造塑料感质感或添加虚构元素。必要时仅可延伸天空、水面、地面、墙体、植物或背景等环境区域。

下半部分必须重建照片的核心叙事内容，无论是一个主要主体还是一组相互关联的代表画面身份、规模、动作或故事的元素。须保留真实的外观、可辨识的身份、比例、内部结构、质感以及相对位置。不得移除重要的相关元素，也不得使用矩形的照片剪贴。重建主体应占据下半部分约 55%–80% 的宽度。应根据场景方向自然延伸主体，保持可信的地面接触、水位线、真实阴影或柔和的淡入边缘。无痕融入背景，避免贴纸感或漂浮感。

在主体后方或局部穿插放置一处窄幅、低饱和度的几何色块，营造摄影写实与编辑抽象之间的微妙过渡。从原始照片中提取颜色，并根据场景的叙事方向确定其水平、垂直或对角的方向。主体必须明显穿越色块边界，一部分与色彩区域重叠，另一部分延伸至开放的负空间。营造自然的遮挡、重叠与空间纵深。色块不得充当边框或卡片，也不得完全包围主体。仅使用一处主要的几何色块。不得添加多重色块、粗边框、圆角、强渐变或投影。

下半部分采用与原始照片协调的白色、冷白、极浅灰或近白背景。保持克制的非对称构图，留有充裕的负空间与清晰的视觉层级：重建主体为第一视觉焦点，低饱和度几何色块为次要元素，纯净背景为衬托空间。

Create a charming, heartwarming two-panel vertical collage inspired by nostalgic childhood photography and handmade children’s crayon drawings.

TOP PANEL — PHOTOREALISTIC PHOTO: Capture a candid, ultra-realistic photograph of a happy young child enjoying a simple outdoor adventure in a beautiful countryside meadow. The child wears colorful, playful everyday clothing and a cute hat or headscarf, with a natural, spontaneous pose interacting with fluffy sheep grazing nearby. Alternatively, capture the child joyfully jumping in the air against a vivid blue sky. Use bright natural sunlight, authentic skin texture, realistic fabric details, soft shadows, natural colors, and an unposed documentary photography aesthetic. BOTTOM PANEL — MATCHING CRAYON DRAWING: Directly beneath the photograph, create a handmade children’s illustration of the exact same child, outfit, pose, and main subjects from the photograph. Use visible wax crayon strokes, colored-pencil scribbles, uneven hand-drawn outlines, imperfect proportions, and a warm ivory paper texture. Add small flowers, grass, clouds, a smiling sun, and playful decorative doodles. COMPOSITION: Stack both panels vertically with a clean horizontal division. The top photograph occupies approximately 60% of the image; the illustrated panel occupies the remaining 40%. Keep the child’s appearance, clothing colors, pose, and surroundings recognizable across both panels. Soft nostalgic colors, cheerful storytelling, wholesome family-album aesthetic, authentic handmade charm, high-quality photorealism in the upper panel, richly textured crayon artwork in the lower panel, portrait 4:5 composition.

IMPORTANT: The two panels must depict the same moment and subject. The upper half must look like a real photograph, while the lower half must look genuinely hand-drawn by a child. Do not blend the illustration into the photograph. Avoid 3D cartoon rendering, digital vector art, overly polished illustrations, artificial skin, and excessive decorative elements.
